newsitem.title: UK: National Power says trading in line.
newsitem.headline: National Power says trading in line.

text.p: British utility National Power Plc said on Tuesday trading in the early part of the year was "broadly in line with directors' expectations."

In a statement to the annual general meeting, the company said pressures on its British generation business were expected to intensify over the next year or two years and prices would reflect rising competition.
The company said overseas earnings were expected to continue growing strongly and, over the long term, to offset the expected decline in British business and lead to resumed growth.
